en: Hetuduka, Saṅkiliṭṭhattika (The Dyad on Roots, the Triad on the Corrupt)

Dependent on a root-condition that is defiled and subject to defilement (*saṅkiliṭṭha-saṅkilesika*), a non-root condition that is not defiled and not subject to defilement (*nasaṅkiliṭṭha-nasaṅkilesika*) arises by way of the root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*)... [In the case of] the root-condition, there are three; ... up to ... in the case of non-disappearance, there are three.

Dependent on a non-root condition that is not defiled and subject to defilement, a non-non-root condition that is not not-defiled and not subject to defilement arises by way of the root-condition... [In the case of] the root-condition, there are three; ... up to ... in the case of non-disappearance, there are three.

Dependent on a root that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement, there arises a rootless phenomenon that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement, by way of root condition … [and so on]. Under root condition, three; … pe … under non-disappearance condition, three.
